name: twikey-payment-xray
description: Shows the manual work in your payment process, counted from your own exports, and prepares this month's work for you: failed collections by bank reason code, mandates past the 36-month rule, payments that match no invoice and payment terms against reality, then collections worth a new attempt, customer mail drafts, mandates to renew and match suggestions. Runs on your own computer, never sends anything and never writes a bank file. Twikey receives nothing.
